Timestamps, durations, wall-clock time, and timebases.

Ports the semantics of symphonia-core/src/units.rs. One timestamp tick equals TimeBase seconds. Time stores seconds plus a non-negative nanosecond fraction.

Note: Symphonia falls back to 128-bit arithmetic on overflow; Nim has no 128-bit integer, so the fallbacks here use float64 (exact for the magnitudes audio timebases produce) or saturate, and overflow-sensitive constructors return Option.

Types

Delta = object
  ticks*: int64
Signed difference between timestamps in ticks. 
Duration = object
  ticks*: uint64
Non-negative span in timebase ticks. 
Time = object
  seconds*: int64
  nanos*: uint32
Wall-clock time: whole seconds plus 0..999_999_999 nanoseconds. 
TimeBase = object
  numer*: uint32
  denom*: uint32
Seconds per tick as numer / denom. Both are always non-zero. 
Timestamp = object
  ticks*: int64
Instant in timebase ticks.

Consts

NsPerSec = 1000000000'u32
ZeroDuration = (ticks: 0'u64)
ZeroTime = (seconds: 0'i64, nanos: 0'u32)
ZeroTimestamp = (ticks: 0'i64)
